title: 第145章 一剑，只需要一剑
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

没有招式，没有剑诀，没有花里胡哨的起手式。

就是简简单单的一剑——从上往下，直劈。

韩奕瞳孔骤缩，本能地在身前凝出了三道护体真元屏障。

筑基中期的真元精纯度虽然不如眼前这个炼气修士，但量上绝对碾压。

三道屏障叠加在一起，厚度接近半尺，表面流转着金、青、蓝三色光芒——金为坚壁，青为卸力，蓝为反弹。

这是他苦修多年的天符宗秘传护身法诀，同阶之中能正面破开的人屈指可数。

然后剑落下来了。

第一道屏障碎了。

碎得毫无征兆。

不是被巨力砸碎的那种四分五裂，而是被剑气从正中间切过去，切口平滑得像是热刀切黄油，屏障表面的金色光芒甚至还没来得及完全暗淡，整面屏障就已经从中间裂成了两半。

第二道屏障也碎了。

碎得比第一道更干脆。

青色的卸力符文在接触到剑气的一瞬间，像是被什么极其纯粹的力量直接抹消了一样，连反应的时间都没有，整面屏障就化作了一片淡青色的光尘消散在空气中。

第三道屏障。

三道屏障，连一剑都没挡住。

韩奕的脸上终于出现了恐惧。

他想退，但剑气已经锁死了他的气机，根本退不了。

他的两条腿像是被钉在了地上一样，连膝盖都弯不下去。

剑锋落下。

韩奕闭上了眼睛。

但预想中的剧痛并没有来。

剑锋在离他额头还有三寸的位置停住了。

停得极其精准，不多一分，不少一毫。

剑身上那股凛冽的青色剑芒依然在流转，剑气依然锋锐如初，但就是稳稳地悬停在那里，纹丝不动。

韩奕睁开眼，额头上的冷汗已经顺着鼻梁淌了下来。

他低头看了一眼自己的脚下——没有后退一步。

不是因为他扛住了，是因为对方根本没打算让他退。

这一剑如果真的劈实了，他的下场不是后退一步，而是直接躺下。

周围的空气安静了整整三秒。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There are no moves, no sword techniques, and no fancy starting moves.

It's just a simple sword strike - straight down from top to bottom.

Han Yi's pupils shrank suddenly, and he instinctively formed three body-protecting true energy barriers in front of him.

Although the purity of the true essence essence in the middle stage of foundation building is not as pure as the Qi Refining monk in front of you, it is absolutely overwhelming in terms of quantity.

The three barriers are stacked together, with a thickness of nearly half a foot, and the surface is filled with gold, green, and blue light - gold is the solid wall, green is the force-relieving force, and blue is the rebound.

This is the secret body-protecting technique of the Tianfu Sect that he has practiced hard for many years. There are only a handful of people at the same level who can break through it head-on.

Then the sword fell.

The first barrier shattered.

Broken without warning.

It was not torn apart like it was smashed by a huge force, but was cut in the middle by the sword energy. The cut was as smooth as a hot knife cutting through butter. The golden light on the surface of the barrier had not even had time to completely dim, and the entire barrier had been split in half from the middle.

The second barrier also shattered.

Crushed more crisply than the first one.

The moment the cyan force-removing rune came into contact with the sword energy, it seemed as if it was directly wiped away by some extremely pure power. Without even time to react, the entire barrier turned into a piece of light cyan light dust and dissipated in the air.

The third barrier.

Three barriers did not stop even a single sword.

Fear finally appeared on Han Yi's face.

He wanted to retreat, but the sword energy had locked his Qi machine and he couldn't retreat at all.

His legs seemed to be nailed to the ground, and he couldn't even bend his knees.

The sword edge fell.

Han Yi closed his eyes.

But the expected severe pain did not come.

The sword edge stopped three inches away from his forehead.

The stop is extremely precise, not a cent more, not a cent less.

The cold green sword light on the sword is still flowing, and the sword energy is still as sharp as ever, but it just hovers there steadily, motionless.

Han Yi opened his eyes, and the cold sweat on his forehead was already dripping down the bridge of his nose.

He glanced down at his feet - without taking a step back.

Not because he endured it, but because the other party had no intention of letting him retreat.

If this sword really hits the target, his end result will not be to take a step back, but to lie down directly.

The surrounding air was quiet for three seconds.
